approval. Which type of repair are you looking for?
user: Do not book or save anything yet. Answer this first: What do a basic bicycle service and puncture repair cost, and are parts included?
assistant: A basic service is four hundred ninety nine rupees and a puncture repair is one hundred twenty rupees. Parts are extra, but only after your approval. Which repair are you looking at today?
user: I do not want a basic service, but I need a puncture repair. Can you help?
assistant: A puncture repair will cost one hundred twenty rupees. Which locality are you in, so I can note that down for you?
Caller shared contact details for the team to follow up.
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
